theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 1 群

items.colloc: draw attention 吸引注意 | draw a conclusion 得出結論
items.distinct: attract 吸引人事物 | sketch 素描
ex: This new campaign will draw many customers.
這項新活動將吸引許多客戶。
Please draw a diagram for the plan.
請為這個計畫畫一張草圖。
He tried to draw money from the bank.
他試圖從銀行提款。

items.colloc: finally decide 最終決定 | finally arrive 終於抵達
items.distinct: at last 終於（強調如釋重負） | eventually 最終（強調過程長）
ex: The report was finally completed this morning.
報告終於在今天早上完成了。
Management finally agreed to our new proposal.
管理層最終同意了我們的新提案。
We finally found a suitable office space.
我們終於找到了合適的辦公空間。

items.pos: v. 顯示；展示 | n. 展覽；演出
items.colloc: show interest 表現出興趣 | show improvement 呈現進步
items.distinct: demonstrate 演示；證明 | display 陳列
ex: The chart shows a rise in sales.
圖表顯示銷售額上升。
She will show the client our new prototype.
她將向客戶展示我們的新原型。
The trade show attracted many international buyers.
這場貿易展吸引了許多國際買家。

items.pos: adj. 公平的；合理的 | n. 展覽會
items.colloc: fair treatment 公平對待 | job fair 就業博覽會
items.distinct: just 正義的 | exhibition 展示會
ex: Every employee deserves a fair salary increase.
每位員工都應得到公平的加薪。
The company organized a local job fair.
公司舉辦了一場在地就業博覽會。
It is only fair to share the workload.
分擔工作量是合理的作法。

items.pos: adj. 各式各樣的；不同的
items.colloc: various reasons 各種原因 | various sizes 各種尺寸
items.distinct: diverse 多樣化的 | several 幾個
ex: We considered various options for the expansion.
我們考慮了擴張的各種方案。
Staff members have various backgrounds in marketing.
員工們在行銷方面有不同的背景。
There are various ways to improve productivity.
有很多方法可以提升生產力。

items.colloc: employee benefits 員工福利 | employee training 員工培訓
items.distinct: employer 雇主 | staff 全體員工
ex: The company values every employee equally.
公司同樣重視每一位員工。
New employees must attend the orientation session.
新進員工必須參加迎新會。
Employee satisfaction is vital to our success.
員工滿意度對我們的成功至關重要。

items.pos: n. 進步；進展 | v. 進行；進步
items.colloc: make progress 取得進展 | steady progress 穩定進展
items.distinct: process 過程 | development 發展
ex: The project is making steady progress daily.
該專案每天都有穩定的進展。
We need to monitor the progress of tasks.
我們需要監控工作任務的進度。
She hopes to progress in her career quickly.
她希望在事業上能快速進步。

items.pos: v. 承辦宴席；迎合需求
items.colloc: cater to the needs 滿足需求 | cater a party 承辦派對
items.distinct: satisfy 滿意 | provide 提供
ex: Our hotel can cater for large corporate events.
我們飯店可以承辦大型企業活動。
We must cater to the changing market trends.
我們必須迎合不斷變化的市場趨勢。
They will cater the dinner for the conference.
他們將為研討會提供餐飲服務。

items.colloc: concentrate on 專注於 | concentrate efforts 集中精力
items.distinct: focus 焦點；聚焦 | pay attention 注意
ex: Please concentrate on your current task list.
請專注於你目前的任務清單。
We should concentrate resources on the main project.
我們應將資源集中在主要專案上。
It is hard to concentrate in a noisy office.
在吵雜的辦公室裡很難專心。

items.colloc: make a payment 付款 | payment method 付款方式
items.distinct: fee 費用 | salary 薪資
ex: The payment is due by the end of month.
付款期限為月底前。
We accept various methods of payment online.
我們線上接受多種付款方式。
Please confirm the payment status with accounting.
請與會計部門確認付款狀態。

items.colloc: prepare for 準備 | prepare a report 準備報告
items.distinct: arrange 安排 | organize 組織
ex: Did you prepare the documents for the meeting?
你有為會議準備文件嗎？
The team is preparing for the upcoming audit.
團隊正在為即將到來的稽核做準備。
She started to prepare a detailed financial plan.
她開始著手準備一份詳細的財務計畫。

items.colloc: key to success 成功的關鍵 | achieve success 獲得成功
items.distinct: achievement 成就 | victory 勝利
ex: Hard work is essential for professional success.
努力工作對於職業成功至關重要。
The launch was a huge success for us.
這次產品發表對我們來說非常成功。
Their success depends on the new marketing strategy.
他們的成功取決於新的行銷策略。

items.colloc: temporary staff 臨時員工 | temporary solution 暫時方案
items.distinct: provisional 臨時的（有條件的） | permanent 永久的
ex: We hired a temporary assistant for the summer.
我們為了夏天聘請了一位臨時助理。
This is only a temporary fix for the bug.
這只是針對該程式錯誤的暫時修復。
The office will be closed for temporary repairs.
辦公室將因臨時維修而暫時關閉。

items.colloc: under construction 施工中 | construction site 建築工地
items.distinct: structure 結構 | building 建築物
ex: The new building is currently under construction.
新大樓目前正在施工中。
The construction project will take two years.
這個營建專案將耗時兩年。
Traffic is delayed due to road construction nearby.
由於附近的道路施工，交通受到延誤。

items.colloc: make a decision 做決定 | reach a decision 達成決定
items.distinct: choice 選擇 | judgment 判斷力
ex: Management has made a final decision today.
管理層今天做出了最終決定。
We need more data before reaching a decision.
我們需要更多數據才能做出決定。
The decision will affect our entire department.
這個決定將會影響我們整個部門。

items.colloc: product development 產品開發 | professional development 專業發展
items.distinct: progress 進步 | growth 成長
ex: The development of new software takes time.
新軟體的開發需要時間。
He is responsible for business development tasks.
他負責業務拓展的工作任務。
Ongoing training aids in professional development.
持續的培訓有助於專業發展。

items.pos: adj. 直接的 | v. 指導；指揮
items.colloc: direct contact 直接聯繫 | direct answer 直接的回答
items.distinct: straight 直的 | manage 管理
ex: Please send your questions to me direct.
請直接將問題發送給我。
The manager directs the team every morning.
經理每天早上指導團隊工作。
We need a direct route to the warehouse.
我們需要一條通往倉庫的直接路線。

items.pos: v. 處理；應付 | n. 把手
items.colloc: handle a complaint 處理投訴 | handle a situation 處理狀況
items.distinct: deal with 處理 | manage 管理
ex: She can handle the pressure of deadlines well.
她能很好地應對截止日期的壓力。
Please handle this delicate matter with care.
請小心處理這件棘手的事。
Our team is trained to handle customer inquiries.
我們的團隊受過處理客戶諮詢的訓練。

items.pos: n. 練習；慣例 | v. 練習
items.colloc: best practice 最佳實務 | business practice 商業慣例
items.distinct: exercise 運動；習題 | habit 習慣
ex: Regular practice helps improve your presentation skills.
規律的練習有助於提升簡報技巧。
This is a standard business practice in Asia.
這是亞洲常見的商業慣例。
We need to practice our pitch before tomorrow.
我們明天之前需要練習提案簡報。

items.colloc: provide information 提供資訊 | provide support 提供支援
items.distinct: supply 供應 | offer 主動提供
ex: The company will provide lunch for all staff.
公司將為所有員工提供午餐。
Please provide your email address for updates.
請提供您的電子郵件地址以接收更新。
The guide provides clear instructions for users.
這份指南為使用者提供了清晰的說明。
